title: console record page: a long text or formula value in the field grid renders on one line with an ellipsis, and the full value is only in a hover tooltip
body:
## What happens

The record detail page's field grid renders a long text value, or a text-returning formula, on one line: `white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis`. The full value is only in the span's `title` tooltip, so touch users and anyone reading it aloud never see it.

- Found by the downstream carbon-black CRM (steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#148, PR #157), measured on @objectstack 18.4.0 in the console as admin, zh-CN and en.
- The formula field `crm_quote_line_item.cb_margin_explanation` (预审说明) is an explanation sentence of about 80–120 characters, such as `… 2026-W46 6520 (山西工厂: 6260 + 260); 7123.89; 8.48% ≥ A 4%`.
- On the line's record page it shows only 「成本周 最低到岸成本（工厂…」, which defeats its purpose: approvers read it to check the margin precheck verdict.

## Why the app cannot fix it

`FieldSchema` offers nothing that lets a formula wrap or take the full row width. `returnType` is `text` only, with no `textarea` / long-text return type, and there is no per-field display width or wrap option. Per the platform-first rule, the default is the fix point. The app adds no workaround.

## Ask

One of these, or both:
1. In the record detail field grid, wrap long `textarea`/long-text values and text formulas, or let them span the full row, instead of truncating to one line.
2. Give text formulas a way to declare a long-text return type, so they render like a `textarea` field.

Acceptance: a 120-character text formula value is fully visible on the record page at 1440 px and at phone width, without hovering.

Dedupe words: record detail long text truncated ellipsis, formula field nowrap title tooltip, field grid full width wrap.
